name: Salt Road
description: A road on the Tarkir steppes that the Abzan patrol polices.

timeline.summary: Riza and his Abzan patrol of fifty march along the Salt Road, and Riza notes the smoke on the horizon is not a Mardu camp.
timeline.quote: But that is no Mardu encampment.

timeline.summary: The patrol finds a shepherds' summer camp destroyed, with every villager killed, and Riza orders the dead buried, fearing the horde of at least one hundred that did it.
timeline.quote: The small village lay in utter desolation. No survivors were left.

timeline.summary: The Mardu horde rides through the night; the Abzan spy buzzard reports it is turning to engage and will arrive before noon.
timeline.quote: The horde has turned south to engage us,

timeline.summary: In a flashback, thirteen-year-old Anafenza lives aboard her house's rolling fortress on the Salt Road.
timeline.quote: At thirteen, she had spent most of her life rumbling from city to city throughout the Abzan lands

timeline.summary: Anafenza is introduced to her cousin Oret and to Gvar Barzeel, a krumar orc raised by her uncle after the battle that killed his Mardu parents and her cousin.
timeline.quote: Gvar was a krumar, which meant he was not born in the Abzan.

timeline.summary: Oret insists the caravan continue to the capital rather than return to Kavah, citing dust storms.
timeline.quote: I must insist we continue to the capital.

timeline.summary: Anafenza lashes out at Gvar, insisting they are not family, and he replies that neither chose their family.
timeline.quote: We're not cousins, Gvar! We're not even family!

timeline.summary: Hakrez, the kin-tree warden, teaches Anafenza that the kin-tree belongs to blood-kin and bond-kin alike.
timeline.quote: This tree belongs to all of them.

timeline.summary: Paala dreams of the night her family's caravan was attacked and her mother fled with her and the baby Refia.
timeline.quote: Paala only running, running, running from a danger she didn't understand

pages_say.description: A road on the Tarkir steppes that the Abzan patrol polices.
The trade road that disappears into the Shifting Wastes from the capital.
A road through the wastes controlled by the Dromoka to supply Purugir Aerie.
A road on Tarkir for which the tavern is often the first or last stop.
The caravan road where Paala's family was attacked.
